title: Use Absence to Increase Respect and Honor
summary: Initial presence builds bonds and respect, but continuous overexposure leads to predictability and a decline in value. Once a strong connection is established, strategic absence creates rarity, sparks imagination, and restores your value and respect.
example: A fair judge of the Medes retired after being taken for granted; the resulting chaos forced the people to recognize his worth and crown him king, a position he preserved by limiting his public appearances.
A poet used distance and reconciliation to revive interest and passion in his romantic relationship when familiarity made it feel common.
reversal: If you withdraw too early before a strong bond is established, you will simply be forgotten instead of missed.
If you fail to create memorable or colorful experiences while present, your absence will not create any value or longing.
